tools.name: search_courses
tools.description: Search Stymie's live US golf-course directory by name, state, city, ZIP code, access type, or hole count. Returns course location, access, holes, architect, scorecard availability, ratings, and exact mileage for ZIP searches.

tools.name: get_course
tools.description: Get full details for a specific golf course by its URL slug. Returns name, location, type, holes, architect, year built, amenities, contact info, ratings, slope stats, and nearby courses.

tools.name: get_scorecard
tools.description: Get the full scorecard for a golf course: all tee sets with hole-by-hole par, yardage, stroke index, and front/back nine ratings. Available for thousands of courses with scorecard data.

tools.name: get_reviews
tools.description: Get user reviews for a golf course. Returns star ratings (1-5), sub-ratings for condition/pace/value, review text, tee played, and reviewer handicap.

tools.name: get_architect
tools.description: Get details about a golf course architect: bio, Wikipedia image, birth/death years, nationality, and all courses they designed grouped by state. Provide either the architect name or URL slug.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: Get the top golf courses in a state by category: hardest (highest slope), easiest (lowest slope, public only), or longest (most yardage). Great for answering "hardest course in NJ" type questions.

tools.name: search_tee_times
tools.description: Search for available tee times at a golf course. Note: Real-time tee time data is coming soon. Currently returns a link to the course page on Stymie where users can set up tee time alerts.

tools.name: search_stymie
tools.description: Search Stymie across golf courses, current equipment, architects, and major site tools. Use this first when the user does not specify which Stymie collection they need.

tools.name: search_equipment
tools.description: Search current golf balls, drivers, putters, rangefinders, and launch monitors. Returns official Stymie detail URLs, images, MSRP, and stated best-for guidance when published.

tools.name: find_nearby_courses
tools.description: Find golf courses within an exact distance of a city, ZIP code, destination, or coordinate. Supports public-access and private filters and returns exact mileage, logo availability, scorecard availability, and maximum slope.

tools.name: build_golf_trip
tools.description: Build a transparent one- to four-course public-access golf trip around a city, ZIP code, destination, or coordinate. Matches real tee yardage and slope data, then balances fit and travel distance. Tee-time availability and drive times must be verified separately.

tools.name: get_deals
tools.description: Get currently verified sale offers for golf equipment. Only in-stock offers checked within the last 48 hours with a current price below list price are returned. Links may be affiliate links, at no extra cost to the buyer.

tools.name: get_data_coverage
tools.description: Return a live count of Stymie course, scorecard, logo, architect, equipment, and current-deal coverage. Use this instead of quoting hardcoded catalog sizes.
